title: Phase 1: Spike — answer the blocking questions
label: phase:1-spike
body: Exit criterion: attribution and the Orca launch environment are confirmed to reach every agent's tool shells. Findings go to `docs/spikes/`. Spec: docs/06-phasing.md, docs/05-open-questions.md.

subs.title: Spike: what does `orca worktree ps --json` return?
subs.body:
Do PIDs, paths and agent state come back? Decides whether attribution can walk the process tree or must rely on paths and labels.

Done when: sample output and a recommendation are in `docs/spikes/orca-worktree-ps.md`.

subs.title: Spike: can Orca set launch command/env per agent?
subs.body:
Can PATH and `HEADROOM_WORKTREE` reach every agent? If not, does a wrapper script as the agent command work (fallback in R9)?

Done when: `docs/spikes/orca-launch-env.md` documents the working mechanism.

subs.title: Spike: does injected PATH survive in Claude CLI and Kilo tool shells?
subs.body:
Test login vs. non-login shells and `path_helper` reordering. `command -v docker` must resolve to a shim dir for both agents.

Done when: `docs/spikes/tool-shell-path.md` has a result matrix.

subs.title: Spike: container memory reporting vs. VM RSS (Docker Desktop, Podman)
subs.body:
Measure how per-container memory differs from the host-side RSS of the VM process on this machine. Informs the 'used' vs 'reserved' numbers.

Done when: `docs/spikes/container-memory.md` has measurements.

subs.title: Decide language and packaging (Python vs Go)
subs.body: Non-blocking open question but needed before Phase 2 scaffolding. Shim must be fast (single static binary favours Go); consider latency budget. Record as ADR in `docs/adr/0001-language.md`.

subs.title: Spike: Kilo CLI before-tool-execution hook?
subs.body: Does Kilo's `.kilo` JS plugin system offer a pre-tool hook that can deny with a message? Decides P1 hook coverage for Kilo.

title: Phase 2: Observe — daemon, budget model, attribution, --watch (R1–R4)
label: phase:2-observe
body: Run for two weeks after completion to collect the baseline and set default thresholds. Blocked by Phase 1. Spec: docs/02-requirements.md R1–R4.

subs.title: Scaffold project (build, CI, lint, tests, config dir)
subs.body: Repo skeleton per ADR 0001, CI workflow, `~/.config/headroom` loader, `headroom` binary entry point.

subs.title: R1: daemon core — collection loop and in-memory budget state
subs.body: Fixed-interval loop, source plug-in interface, unix socket API for clients.

subs.title: R1: Docker/Podman collector
subs.body: Docker-compatible API socket: per-container memory and labels; VM ceiling (`docker info` / `podman machine inspect`); host-side VM process RSS; warn when Docker Desktop and Podman VMs both run.

subs.title: R1: Tart collector
subs.body: `tart list`: configured memory, state, disk size.

subs.title: R1: LM Studio collector
subs.body: Loaded model and size from local API (resolve whether memory or only file size is exposed).

subs.title: R1: Orca collector
subs.body: `orca worktree ps --json` plus agent status hooks (working/waiting/done).

subs.title: R1: host memory pressure and swap (no sudo) with 5-min trend
subs.body: Sample every interval; keep trend history for the top line.

subs.title: R2: budget model (reserved vs used vs headroom)
subs.body: Reserved = container VM ceiling + running Tart VM memory + loaded model + host baseline; idle models still reserved; headroom = 64 GB − reserved.

subs.title: R3: worktree attribution
subs.body: Containers by compose label, bind mount path or process cwd; Tart by name convention or `tart run` cwd; everything else unattributed. Test: container from `fix-login` shows under `fix-login`.

subs.title: R4: observe view — `headroom` and `headroom --watch`
subs.body: Top line (total/reserved/used/headroom/swap/pressure/trend), per-worktree rows, waiting/done-but-holding marker, unattributed row, ungated flag (needs R10 leases, stub until Phase 3).

subs.title: Daemon lifecycle: launchd agent, install/uninstall, logs
subs.body: Run as a user LaunchAgent; `headroom daemon` subcommands.

subs.title: Baseline: two-week observe run, set default thresholds
subs.body: Collect data; decide default min headroom, per-worktree cap and host baseline; write results to `docs/baseline.md`.

title: Phase 3: Gate — launch env, shims, leases, slot gate, fail-open, policy (R5–R10)
label: phase:3-gate
body: Exit criterion: agents recover from denies without human help in most cases. Blocked by Phase 2. Spec: docs/02-requirements.md R5–R10.

subs.title: R8: policy engine (min headroom, per-worktree cap, idle-holder rule)
subs.body: Allow/wait/deny decision from budget; config in `~/.config/headroom`; waiting/done agents holding idle resources cannot start new ones.

subs.title: R10: leases
subs.body: Reserve estimated cost on allow until the resource appears or 2-min timeout; log expiries. Test: two 6 GB requests with 8 GB headroom → exactly one allowed.

subs.title: R5: shim core — real-binary resolution and passthrough
subs.body: Remove own dir from PATH, never self-call, `exec` real binary, resolve `docker`→`podman` alias.

subs.title: R5: command parser for docker/podman/tart
subs.body: Handle global flags and long forms (`--context`, `container run`, `compose -f … up`); recognise run/create/start/compose up/tart run/clone; others pass through without daemon contact.

subs.title: R5: identity resolution and deny/wait UX
subs.body: HEADROOM_WORKTREE → git toplevel → process ancestry; no worktree = `manual`. Exit 75 with agent-oriented message naming reusable idle resources; `BUDGET_WAIT=1` queues with timeout.

subs.title: R6: macOS VM slot gate
subs.body: Count-first gate (2 macOS VMs); name slot holders, waiting/done agents first; queue support.

subs.title: R7: fail-open
subs.body: 500 ms daemon timeout → exec real binary with one-line warning; never block non-creating commands. Include latency benchmark.

subs.title: R9: Orca launch environment integration
subs.body: Set shim dir first on PATH and `HEADROOM_WORKTREE` per agent using the mechanism found in the spike; wrapper-script fallback.

subs.title: R9: `headroom doctor`
subs.body: Check PATH order and identity inside a worktree terminal; report what's wrong. Verify for Claude CLI and Kilo.

subs.title: R4: ungated detection using leases
subs.body: Flag containers/VMs with no matching lease (direct socket, Testcontainers, broken PATH).

subs.title: Gate rollout: enable, measure deny recovery rate
subs.body: Run two weeks with gate on; compare against baseline metrics in docs/04-metrics.md.

subs.title: Audit log of allow/deny/wait decisions
subs.body: Record worktree, command and numbers; feeds metrics.

subs.title: Learned cost estimates
subs.body: Record peak memory per compose project/image; estimate by p95, conservative default for unknown.

subs.title: Advise mode
subs.body: Back-off messages via `orca terminal send` or worktree comment; manual from view or automatic on red pressure.

subs.title: Tart disk view
subs.body: Per-clone disk usage; flag clones whose worktree is gone.

subs.title: LM Studio swap counter
subs.body: Loads/evictions in the last hour with triggering agent where inferable.

subs.title: MCP tool: budget.check / budget.status
subs.body: Let agents ask before planning work.

subs.title: Claude Code PreToolUse hook (and Kilo equivalent if available)
subs.body: Advisory early warning and session-level attribution; shim stays authoritative.

subs.title: Linux Tart guests
subs.body: Outside two-VM limit; memory-gated like containers.

subs.title: Placement advice for Orca remote runtimes
subs.body: Which worktrees should move given local headroom.

subs.title: Priority ordering (foreground worktree first)
subs.body: Human's foreground worktree gets precedence in the policy.

subs.title: Full TUI (Textual)
subs.body: After `--watch` shows which columns matter.
